```{r}
# Loading the data, concatenating the top (A) and bottom (B) parts of the cores

load_data = function(folder, file) {
  file_path = file.path(folder, file)
  df = read_excel(
    path = file_path,
    sheet = 1
  )
  df = subset(df, select = -c(layer_title))
  return(df)
}

core_3A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_A.xlsx")
core_3B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_B.xlsx")

core_4A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_A.xlsx")
core_4B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_B.xlsx")


core_3 = bind_rows(
  core_3A,
  core_3B |> mutate(depth_mm = depth_mm + max(core_3A$depth_mm))
)

core_4 = bind_rows(
  core_4A,
  core_4B |> mutate(depth_mm = depth_mm + max(core_4A$depth_mm))
)

```

```{r}
smooth = function(x, window) {
  as.numeric(
    stats::filter(x, rep(1/window, window), sides = 2)
  )
}
detrend = function(x, window) {
  x - smooth(x, window)
}

# Applying across all cores and window sizes
for (window in c(5, 11, 21)) {
  for (core_name in c("core_3A", "core_3B", "core_4A", "core_4B")) {
    
    df = get(core_name)
    for (axis in c("L_star", "a_star", "b_star")) {
      df[[paste0(axis, "_smooth_", window)]] =
        smooth(df[[axis]], window)
      df[[paste0(axis, "_detrend_", window)]] =
        detrend(df[[axis]], window)
    }
    assign(core_name, df)
  }
}

```


```{r}
# Plotting a single dim from both cores
```

```{r}
# Performing a Pearson cross-correlation
series_1 <- core_3B
series_2 <- core_4B

axis <- "L_star_smooth_21"

depth_step <- 0.1
max_lag_mm <- 1000



# Common overlapping depth range
depth_min <- max(
  min(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  min(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
)

depth_max <- min(
  max(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Common depth grid
depth <- seq(
  depth_min,
  depth_max,
  by = depth_step
)

# Interpolate onto common depth grid
x1 <- approx(
  x = series_1$depth_mm,
  y = series_1[[axis]],
  xout = depth,
  ties = mean
)$y

x2 <- approx(
  x = series_2$depth_mm,
  y = series_2[[axis]],
  xout = depth,
  ties = mean
)$y

# Remove positions where either profile is NA
valid <- !is.na(x1) & !is.na(x2)

x1 <- x1[valid]
x2 <- x2[valid]

# Cross-correlation
result <- ccf(
  x1,
  x2,
  lag.max = max_lag_mm / depth_step,
  plot = FALSE
)

# Convert lag to actual depth offset in mm
lag_mm <- as.vector(result$lag) * depth_step
correlation <- as.vector(result$acf)
```


```{r}
i_pos <- which.max(correlation[lag_mm > 0])
i_pos <- which(lag_mm > 0)[i_pos]

i_neg <- which.max(correlation[lag_mm < 0])
i_neg <- which(lag_mm < 0)[i_neg]

i <- c(i_neg, i_pos)

results <- data.frame(
  correlation = correlation[i],
  offset_mm = lag_mm[i]
)

results

```



```{r}

plot_ccf = function(lag_mm, correlation, results) {

  df = data.frame(
    lag_mm = lag_mm,
    correlation = correlation
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = lag_mm, y = correlation)) +

    # Zero correlation line
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Cross-correlation
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        x = lag_mm,
        xend = lag_mm,
        y = 0,
        yend = correlation
      ),
      colour = "grey60",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +

    # Highlighted peaks
    geom_segment(
      data = results,
      aes(
        x = offset_mm,
        xend = offset_mm,
        y = 0,
        yend = correlation
      ),
      colour = "blue",
      linewidth = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    # Peak labels
    geom_text(
      data = results,
      aes(
        x = offset_mm,
        y = correlation,
        label = paste0(
          round(offset_mm, 1), " mm ",
          "(r = ", round(correlation, 2), ")"
        )
      ),
      vjust = -0.7,
      size = 3,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "Cross-correlation of L* for the lower sections of MI-24-03 and MI-24-04",
      x = "Lag (mm)",
      y = "Pearson correlation (r)",
      caption = "Highlighted lines indicate the two strongest correlation peaks."
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0
      )
    )
}

plot_ccf(lag_mm, correlation, results)
```






```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height=8}
plot_cores = function(core_3B, core_4B, results) {

  # Negative-lag correlation peak
  offset_mm = results$offset_mm[results$offset_mm < 0]

  make_plot_data = function(df, core_name, x_pos, offset_mm = 0) {
    df |>
      mutate(
        core = core_name,
        x = x_pos,
        plot_depth_cm = (depth_mm + offset_mm) / 10,
        colour = rgb(
          R_mean,
          G_mean,
          B_mean,
          maxColorValue = 255
        )
      )
  }

  plot_data = bind_rows(
    make_plot_data(core_3B, "MI-24-03B", 1.000),
    make_plot_data(core_4B, "MI-24-04B", 1.018, offset_mm)
  )

  ggplot(plot_data) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = plot_depth_cm,
        fill = colour
      ),
      width = 0.015,
      height = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1.000, 1.018),
      labels = c("MI-24-03B", "MI-24-04B"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Alignment of the lower sections of MI-24-03 and MI-24-04",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Depth (cm)",
      caption = paste0(
        "MI-24-04 offset by ",
        round(offset_mm / 10, 1),
        " cm based on the cross-correlation of L*."
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0)
    )
}

plot_cores(core_3B, core_4B, results)
```








```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height=8}
plot_core_images = function(
  image_3B,
  image_4B,
  core_3B,
  core_4B,
  results
) {

  # ==========================================================
  # OFFSET
  # ==========================================================

  offset_mm = results$offset_mm[results$offset_mm < 0]


  # ==========================================================
  # CROP IMAGE TO THE ROWS ACTUALLY REPRESENTED BY THE DATA
  # ==========================================================

  crop_to_data = function(image, df) {

    info = image_info(image)

    image_width = info$width
    image_height = info$height

    row_min = floor(min(df$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))
    row_max = ceiling(max(df$image_row_px, na.rm = TRUE))

    # Keep crop inside image
    row_min = max(0, row_min)
    row_max = min(image_height, row_max)

    crop_height = row_max - row_min

    image_crop(
      image,
      geometry = paste0(
        image_width,
        "x",
        crop_height,
        "+0+",
        row_min
      )
    )
  }


  image_3B_crop = crop_to_data(
    image_3B,
    core_3B
  )

  image_4B_crop = crop_to_data(
    image_4B,
    core_4B
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # CONVERT TO RASTERS
  # ==========================================================

  raster_3 = as.raster(image_3B_crop)
  raster_4 = as.raster(image_4B_crop)


  # ==========================================================
  # DEPTH RANGES
  # ==========================================================

  depth_3_min = min(
    core_3B$depth_mm,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  depth_3_max = max(
    core_3B$depth_mm,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  depth_4_min = min(
    core_4B$depth_mm,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) + offset_mm

  depth_4_max = max(
    core_4B$depth_mm,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) + offset_mm


  # ==========================================================
  # PLOT
  # ==========================================================

  ggplot() +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_3,
      xmin = 0,
      xmax = 1,
      ymin = depth_3_min,
      ymax = depth_3_max,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    annotation_raster(
      raster_4,
      xmin = 1.1,
      xmax = 2.1,
      ymin = depth_4_min,
      ymax = depth_4_max,
      interpolate = TRUE
    ) +

    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(
        max(depth_3_max, depth_4_max),
        min(depth_3_min, depth_4_min)
      ),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(0.5, 1.6),
      labels = c(
        "MI-24-03B",
        "MI-24-04B"
      ),
      limits = c(-0.05, 2.15),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(
      title =
        "Alignment of the lower sections of MI-24-03 and MI-24-04",

      x = NULL,

      y = "Depth (mm)",

      caption = paste0(
        "MI-24-04 offset by ",
        round(offset_mm, 1),
        " mm based on the cross-correlation of L*."
      )
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),

      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0
      )
    )
}


plot_core_images(
  image_3B,
  image_4B,
  core_3B,
  core_4B,
  results
)
```
